declaration: detailed analysis choices finalized after data collection, before aggregate score inspection; not a prospective preregistration
attempt_policy: first attempts only; no silent retry substitution
timing_policy: all three repetitions retained within question; paired bootstrap weights shared between comparison sides

source_clusters.hotpot_qa: connected components of selected questions sharing supporting document IDs or casefolded titles, including passage variants

uncertainty: 2000 paired whole-source-cluster percentile resamples; question-cluster sensitivity reported separately; interval unavailable below two clusters
macro: equal-dataset average of dataset-specific estimates and stratified resamples; not pooled independent repetitions or a pooled latency percentile
output_instability: question rate with any raw or normalized answer disagreement across repetitions; descriptive only
multiplicity: descriptive unadjusted intervals for all declared contrasts; no significance-based winner selection
limits: tail estimates unstable at small sample sizes
gold is not a guaranteed upper bound
baseline/main online paths and source fingerprints differ
historical v1/v2 never imported or pooled
no reruns or held-out parameter tuning
normal_command: python -m ragbench_lab stage-b-report configs/stage-a-study.toml --study manifests/stage-b-study-v3-reduced.json --baseline-plan manifests/stage-b-baselines-v1.json --main-run runs/stage-b-evaluation-v3 --baseline-run runs/baseline-evaluation-v1 --squad-dir data/prepared/squad-study-v1 --hotpot-dir data/prepared/hotpot-study-v1 --protocol configs/analysis-protocol.json --archive artifacts/archives/ragbench-core-v1.zip --output NEW_REPORT_DIRECTORY
